QuestInfo.name: Stranger's Request
QuestInfo.0: I hear someone's been seen inside the #m10003004# in #m10003000#...
QuestInfo.1: I met #b#p412##k inside the #m10003004# in #m10003000#. #b#p412##k needs to take off her bandages to see the results of her surgery, but there's no mirror in the nearly abandoned building. #b#p412##k asked me to defeat #r40 #o17#s#k and collect #b20 #t4031007#s#k, so she could take a look at herself...
QuestInfo.2: I actually collected #t4031007# for the stranger I met in the #m10003004# and brought it back to her.

0.0: Man, why is it so cold here??? Um, hey... Do you know where Dr. Niora is, by any chance? Today's the day I get these bandages off, but I can't see anything. I need to see if the surgery went well. If you've got time, can you help me out??

yes.0: Ah... Thank you so much for agreeing to help me. I really want to take these bandages off and look in the mirror, but it seems there's no mirror in the hospital. I heard that #r#o17#s#k, who live in the subway, may give out pieces of #b#t4031007##k. Please #rdefeat 40 of them#k and bring me #b20 pieces of #t4031007##k... By the way, why is it so cold around here? Sigh... it's freezing.

no.0: ... ... I guess that's a no. Why is it so darn cold around here?? And where is Dr. Niora??

1.0: You're back... and with the pieces of #t4031007#... Thank you so much.

item.0: I don't think you've gathered up #b20 pieces of #t4031007##k yet. Please get them for me... It's waaay too cold around here.

mob.0: Don't forget, you also need to defeat #r40 #o17#s#k...
